title: 只给3人的奖金池：被反对声撑到20人，总额超5亿美元？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's turn down to Wall Street, Goldman's top executives are poised to collect special bonuses, totaling more than $500 million. It would rank among the biggest payouts the firm has ever
segments.zh: 把目光转向华尔街，高盛高层即将获得特别奖金，总额超过5亿美元。这将是该公司有史以来最大手笔之一。

segments.en: awarded. Let's get more with Bloomberg's chief Wall Street correspondent, Shredar Naderajan. I mean, I would hope so, Shree, considering that they've had
segments.zh: 我们请彭博首席华尔街记者Shredar Naderajan来解读。考虑到他们业绩爆表，我觉得这也不意外。

segments.en: blowout results. Yeah, but what's really interesting about this is this was never meant to be.
segments.zh: 但有趣的是，这原本并非计划中的安排。

segments.en: Like every other bank, this award that was put in place in 2021 was only supposed to be for the top two or three executives. But there was some pushback from shareholders. There was a lot of
segments.zh: 和其他银行一样，2021年设立的这项奖励原本只针对两三位最高层。但股东有反对声音，员工也普遍担忧，

segments.en: concern among employees as to why David Solomon and his deputy were getting a special bonus grant.
segments.zh: 为什么苏德巍及其副手能拿到特别奖金。

segments.en: At a time when, you know, just a few months earlier, that same Goldman Sachs board had docked $10 million from David Solomon's pay because he was in charge of the banking group
segments.zh: 就在几个月前，高盛董事会还因他负责的银行业务组卷入1MDB贿赂丑闻，扣了他1000万美元薪酬。

segments.en: when that 1MDB bribery scandal happened. Goldman's role in helping that loot of that investment fund in Malaysia and some senior executives had to, you know, there was penance for it and
segments.zh: 高盛在协助马来西亚**基金资金被挪用中扮演了角色，一些高管为此付出了代价，

segments.en: $10 million was Solomon's price. So after the pushback, what happened was Goldman Sachs board decided to expand these awards to their top roughly 20 executives, at least 20 are still remaining
segments.zh: 1000万美元就是Solomon的代价。在反对声之后，高盛董事会决定将奖励扩大到约20位高层，当时至少还有20人。

segments.en: a little more back then. And as a result, as you come through to 2026, five years on with what we've seen in markets, the incredible environment it has been for capital markets across the IPO market,
segments.zh: 结果到2026年，五年过去，市场环境对资本市场极为有利，IPO、并购和交易活动都非常活跃。

segments.en: deal making, the trading activity. Goldman's in a really sweet spot for all of that. So of course, the stock has done really well. It is now close to $900 per share. Roughly the same level where it
segments.zh: 高盛正好处于有利位置，股价表现很好，现在接近每股900美元，大致回到之前的水平。

segments.en: was a year ago, but over the last five years, it has gone up quite a bit, 150% returns of the
segments.zh: 一年前还是这样，但过去五年涨幅相当大，回报率达到150%
